class="jsx-1f08e45442ec1fc9 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 arrow-icon--open"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" answer-grid__content"><div class="jsx-1f08e45442ec1fc9 flex items-center pr-8 pb-4 w-full"><p class="jsx-1f08e45442ec1fc9 answer-text flex-1 text-base leading-6 whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) answer-text--open">Kimi 网页版适合快速对话和查询，而 Kimi Work 是专为深度工作流设计的本地智能体。它可以挂载本地文件夹、通过 Kimi 浏览器扩展 自主浏览网页、在后台运行 Python 代码并执行定时任务，是一名系统级的数字员工。</p></div></div></div></div><div shrink-0"><button class="jsx-1f08e45442ec1fc9 flex justify-between items-center py-4 pr-4 pl-0 w-full text-left cursor-pointer"><h3 class="jsx-1f08e45442ec1fc9 text-base leading-6 font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">Kimi Work 在访问本地文件时如何保护我的隐私？</h3><div class="jsx-1f08e45442ec1fc9 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="block max-w-none arrow-icon size-full"><path fill-opacity="0.9" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10.75 "><div class="jsx-1f08e45442ec1fc9 answer-grid__content"><div class="jsx-1f08e45442ec1fc9 flex items-center pr-8 pb-4 w-full"><p class="jsx-1f08e45442ec1fc9 answer-text flex-1 text-base leading-6 whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) ">你对文件拥有绝对控制权。内置的操作前询问安全保障确保 Kimi 桌面端在修改、覆盖或在本地目录中运行代码之前，会提示你明确授权。未经你的同意，任何操作都不会执行。</p></div></div></div></div><div class="jsx-1f08e45442ec1fc9 flex flex-col overflow-clip border-b-[0.5px] border-(--Separators-S1) "><div class="jsx-1f08e45442ec1fc9 flex isolate relative flex-col items-center w-full overflow-clip shrink-0"><button text-(--Labels-Primary)">Kimi 浏览器扩展（浏览器自动化）具体能帮我做什么？</h3><div class="jsx-1f08e45442ec1fc9 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="block max-w-none arrow-icon size-full"><path fill-opacity="0.9" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10.75 8.406a.6.6 0 0 0 whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) ">Kimi 浏览器扩展 让 Kimi Work 具备像人类一样使用浏览器的能力。你可以让它查看网站上的最新资讯并总结，或抓取历史股票数据保存到本地 Excel。它自主点击、滚动和提取数据，为你节省大量手动操作时间。</p></div></div></div></div><div whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">定时任务能做什么？电脑休眠时还能运行吗？</h3><div class="jsx-1f08e45442ec1fc9 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) ">我们的 Cron 调度器支持 LLM Agent 调用、Python/Shell 执行等多种任务类型。你可以在 Kimi 客户端设置定时任务类型，如每天、每小时或按条件触发。为确保任务在夜间无缝运行，只需在设置中开启保持电脑唤醒选项即可。</p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></section></div></main><!--$--><!--/$--></main><footer id="site-footer" class="bg-[#121212]"
